# New Image Dental

> New Image Dental in Inglewood offers comprehensive cosmetic, restorative, and emergency dental care with specialized sedation options for anxious patients.

Led by Dr. Marina Adams, DDS, New Image Dental serves the Inglewood and Los Angeles area with advanced treatments including dental implants, veneers, whitening, and sleep dentistry. The practice specializes in helping patients overcome dental anxiety through sedation options while providing cosmetic and restorative solutions.
